main_text.p: Jerufalem. Etimpingent multiin his (of-fendiculis,) corruent & conterentur, irre-tientur & capientur.Liga conteftationem: obfigna legem cum difcipulis meis.Et ex-peftabo Dominum, qui abfconditfaciem fuam à domoIacob, & præftolabor eum. Ecce ego &pueri, quos dedit mihi Domi-nus in figna &prodigia in Ifrael: à Domi-no exercituum, qui habitat in môte Zion, (hæc funt.)Et fi dixerintad uos:Scifcitami ni pythonicos, diuinos qui mufsitant & di stant: Nunquid non populus cofulit deos fuos?num pro uiuis ad mortuos(recurren-dum?) Per legem & teftimonium,fi non di xerintiuxta fermonem iftum, in quo nihil eftlucis. Tranfiens autem per ipsam (ter-ram,)grauabitur & efuriet,eritq; cum efu-rierit, moleftabitur apudfe,& maledicet regi fuo atque Deo fuo, & facie furfum a-fpiciet. Et cum fpeftauerit ad terram,ec-ce tribulatio & tenebræ,caligo &anguftia, obfcuritas &impulfio. Necobfcuratus eft ille cui hæc accidit anguftia iuxta tempus illud primũ,quando (hoftis)alleuiauit ter-ram Zebulun,& terram Naphthali: poste-rior autem aggrauauit (eos,)per uiam ma-ris ultra Iordanem,in Galilæa gentium.

page.notes: Page number printed as "8o" at top left; the final character may be an o or a 0, read as printed. Printing errors left as printed: "multiin", "stant" (long s form in the printed text is read as s), "Necobfcuratus", "eftlucis", "tempus illud", "Scifcitami", "dixerintad". Several words run together in the print, such as "(hoftis)alleuiauit" and "fuam à domoIacob", and are copied as printed. Converted by the u/v and i/j rules: uos, uiuis, uiam, Jerufalem, Jacob, Jordanem, juxta, Jesaiae.
